ddl.name: channel_message_content_present
ddl.value: ("text" IS NOT NULL AND length("text") > 0) OR "attachment_id" IS NOT NULL OR "deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR "location_lat" IS NOT NULL OR "has_poll"

ddl.name: channel_message_location_pair
ddl.value: ("location_lat" IS NULL AND "location_lng" IS NULL) OR ("location_lat" IS NOT NULL AND "location_lng" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: channel_message_location_range
ddl.value: "location_lat" IS NULL OR ("location_lat" >= -90 AND "location_lat" <= 90 AND "location_lng" >= -180 AND "location_lng" <= 180)

ddl.name: direct_message_content_present
ddl.value: ("text" IS NOT NULL AND length("text") > 0) OR "attachment_id" IS NOT NULL OR "deleted_at" IS NOT NULL OR "location_lat" IS NOT NULL OR "has_poll"

ddl.name: direct_message_location_pair
ddl.value: ("location_lat" IS NULL AND "location_lng" IS NULL) OR ("location_lat" IS NOT NULL AND "location_lng" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: direct_message_location_range
ddl.value: "location_lat" IS NULL OR ("location_lat" >= -90 AND "location_lat" <= 90 AND "location_lng" >= -180 AND "location_lng" <= 180)
